# Reactive props destructure rewrites shadowed catch and switch bindings (issue #16098)

### Version
3.5.44

### Reproduction link
[play.vuejs.org/](https://play.vuejs.org/#)







### Steps to reproduce
Open the linked SFC Playground with Vue 3.5.44 and inspect the two rendered paragraphs. The component captures a local message in catch and declares another local message in a switch case.

### What is expected?
The preview displays catch: caught and switch: case. The inner variables shadow the prop with the same name.

### What is actually happening?
Both paragraphs display prop. The compiler rewrites the local references to __props.message.

---
Also reproduced with @vue/compiler-sfc 3.6.0-rc.14. A related catch parameter-default case can throw ReferenceError when a same-named binding is declared only in the catch body. The regression tests execute the compiled component. Reproduction checked in headless Chrome on Windows with Node 24.15.0. Related scope fixes #12792 and #14933 address different cases.
